title: Admin Surface Design Guideline
summary: Binding admin-surface standard: flat full-bleed composition, compact disclosure-first headers, one grid for stream entries, non-redundant sober copy, project identity, operator-grade density, bounded prose width, theme tokens, and locally hosted fonts. Includes a fully specified Activity reference, a screenshot-backed violation audit, an incremental adoption contract, an explicit prohibition on nested outcome-summary boxes, the details-panel addendum, the append-only Navigation citizenship chapter with three light/dark Tree variants, a neutral waiting-decision counter recommendation, state rules, a follow-up slice boundary, visual Dos and Don'ts pairs, and an append-only Applied surfaces register. [Curation 2026-08-17: stays current as a binding living standard. AGENTS.md makes it mandatory reading for admin surface work, and AGT-2579 and AGT-2617 are still in lane 5-human-review, so it is not closable. The former status "living-standard" and phase "accepted" are outside the descriptor vocabulary and made this Dossier render as "Descriptor needs repair"; they are corrected to active/informational, meaning a standing reference with no operator decision pending.]
